clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and methods of sampling and test for hydraulic setting thermal insulating castables for use as either hot face or cold face backing of refractory linings, at temperatures up to 12500C.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types a) Type 1050 - Suitable for use at temperatures up to 1 0500C, and b) Type 1 250-  Suitable for use at temperatures up to 1 2500C.

clauses.title: General – Shall be
clauses.text: 3.1 General -  Shall be in the form of dry powder with maximum grain size 5 mm.

clauses.title: Moisture Content – Shall
clauses.text: 3.2 Moisture Content -  Shall not contain more than 2 percent moisture by mass.

clauses.title: The material shall also
clauses.text: 3.3 The material shall also conform to the reqirements given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Ferric Oxide Content –
